name: henshin-moves
title_zh: 改宝可梦招式手感前先读穿弹道ID的mod动作师
tagline_zh: 调技能/终极技的打击感与特效，不用瞎试。先按宝可梦招式语义和Terraria弹道ID推预期效果。
tagline_en: Tune Pokemon move/ultimate feel & VFX without blind trial. Reads move meaning + Terraria projectile IDs first.
desc_en: Iterates Pokemon Henshin move/skill/ultimate combat logic and VFX for this Terraria+tModLoader+Calamity mod. Use when designing or changing skills, ultimates, FormItemUtil factories, Wave2/Shared/Redesigned move projectiles, HenshinFxDraw, move FX polish, or when the user asks to improve a move's feel or visuals. Read Pokemon move meaning and Terraria projectile IDs first, propose an expected-effe
why_zh: 它把「招式语义→弹道ID→特效绘制」串成一条可推理链，改前先给预期效果，改后不靠手感玄学。
why_en: Chains move meaning → projectile ID → FX drawing into one inferable path. Predicts feel before you edit, so you iterate combat.
limit_zh: 只认tModLoader+Calamity环境下的此mod代码结构；不处理非宝可梦招式、不生成新弹道贴图。
limit_en: Only for this mod's tModLoader+Calamity codebase. No new projectile sprites, no server sync, no non-Pokemon moves. Requires mod source & build env.
title_en: Pokemon move feel tuner that reads projectile IDs first
